title: Signal Mosaic: Biweekly Regression & Onboard Eval Brief (2026-05-18)
summary: This brief summarizes the biweekly scan of onboarding evals, promptset coverage, and newly observed regressions for three models promoted to staging between 2026-05-04 and 2026-05-17. The goal is to call out high-impact failure patterns, short-term mitigations, and proposed promptset/telemetry changes for the next sprint.
highlights: Overall regression rate on new promptsets increased to 4.7% (up from 2.1% last cycle) driven by a single pattern cluster
Promptset coverage remains 82% across primary task families but coverage quality (oracle pass) dropped in multi-step math and API-integration scenarios
Three onboarding models (gpt-redwood-2-7b, redwood-x2-medium, openbart-v1) show divergent failure modes — recommend per-model short fixes
Added lightweight assertion telemetry hooks on 6 prompt templates; initial signals show +10% faster triage for failures with structured metadata
key_metrics: False-positive alert rate after threshold tuning: 12% -> 7%
failure_clusters: Numerical chain-of-thought collapse: model truncates mid-calculation, producing plausible but incorrect intermediate steps (31 examples)
Context bleed on tool-usage prompts: model repeats API spec instead of returning structured response (14 examples)
Hallucinated entity normalization: diverging casing/format causing downstream match failures (8 examples)
Policy/guard misfires on benign prompts: overzealous refusal on negotiation tasks (6 examples)
example_vignettes: Numeric collapse — prompt 'Calculate 14*23 then divide by 7' -> model returns '14*23=282, divide by 7 = 40.2' (incorrect division step). Fails numeric-check postassertion.
Tool context bleed — prompt includes JSON schema for invoice -> model echoes schema and comments instead of returning filled JSON. Breaks integration tests.
Entity normalization — customer id 'usr_00A' vs 'USR-00A' mismatch caused rerank to fail downstream mapping in 3 datapoints.
short_triage_actions: Add quick numeric validator on math prompt family to surface intermediate arithmetic mismatches
Temporarily pin redwood-x2-medium to older tokenizer on staging for integration tests (rollback if no regression)
Mark 6 prompt templates for structured-output enforcement via scaffolded few-shot examples

promptset_changes_proposed: Introduce 3 scaffolded examples for API/json-return templates to reduce schema-echo failure
Add counterexamples to multi-step math prompts to discourage hallucinated intermediate reasoning
Split one large 'customer-support' promptset into focused families: billing, onboarding, account-management (improves signal granularity)
telemetry_and_instrumentation_recs: Persist per-example assertion outputs to S3 for 90 days (path in linked_artifacts)
Add an ephemeral 'calc-check' flag in harness to compute precise numeric diffs when math-family templates run
Surface a new Dashboard tile for 'structured-output echo' rate by model and promptset (weekly rollup)
follow_up_meeting: Sync (30m) 2026-05-20 10:00 PT — participants: eng-applied-ml leads + SRE rep + solutions-eng. Agenda: triage numeric DSL results, approve prompt scaffolds, sign off telemetry rollout schedule.
note: This brief leans pragmatic: the largest ROI is small invariant checks + prompt scaffolds. Longer-term work (kernel-level quantization/latency tradeoffs) deferred until onboarding regressions <1%. Keep sprint focus narrow.
